items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He gave me my first idea of how to play it, how to put the mouthpiece on, how to finger a scale, a C scale.

ctx.x: Did he have any – what did he do with you, relative to the saxophone, besides giving you a saxophone?

He gave me my first idea of how to play it, how to put the mouthpiece on, how to finger a scale, a C scale. Then he took me directly down to the New York School of Music and enrolled me there. He didn’t have to teach me anymore. He never taught me anything after that.
Tell us about your experience at that school of music.
